BiblicalUsage: Dusky — the day of the Lord described as darkness and not light, darkness with no brightness in it. One verse, and the whole warning in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day of the Lord is darkness for those who trusted in their own religion, and that is why Amos still frightens me in a good way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
